situation: You wake at 3 am. Your husband is at the kitchen table with a calculator, adding up the future.

scenario.title: 3 am, Kitchen Table
scenario.setting: A dim kitchen at 3 am, one pendant light, bills and a calculator on the table, a cold mug.
scenario.user_goal: Be with him and find out what is really keeping him up.
user_knows: The mortgage rate went up this year
Your son starts college in three years

cast.name: Dan
cast.appearance: Man about 47, grey T-shirt, reading glasses pushed up, unshaven, pencil in hand
cast.secret: His name is on a rumoured layoff list at work
cast.reveal_when: You sit with him and stop offering fixes

cast.name: Your mother
cast.appearance: Woman about 72, quilted robe, slippers, white hair loose, holding a glass of water
cast.voice: Soft, unhurried, says little but it lands
cast.history: She's here for her check-up week.
cast.secret: She has quietly saved a little account in your son's name
cast.reveal_when: You ask how she got through bad years

cast.name: Paul
cast.role: his old friend, texting then calling
cast.appearance: Man about 48, seen on a phone screen, sitting in a parked car at night
cast.goal: Let his friend know what he heard
cast.secret: He's opening a shop and wants your husband as a partner
cast.reveal_when: You ask why he's calling so late

scenario.opening_line: Hey. Go back to bed. It's nothing, just—numbers.

events.description: A door opens down the hall. Your mother shuffles in for a glass of water.
events.shot: An older woman in a robe stands at the kitchen door with a glass; the man looks up.

events.description: His phone buzzes on the table at this hour. He looks at it and then at you.
events.shot: A phone glows on the kitchen table showing a video call from a man in a parked car.

events.description: He takes his glasses off and pushes the calculator away.
events.shot: The man has pushed the calculator aside and sits rubbing his eyes under the pendant light.

success_criteria: Gets him to say what's wrong
Doesn't try to fix it right away

Dan.name: A list with one name circled
